name: Swiss Ball Plank
instructions: Place your forearms on a Swiss ball in a plank, body in a straight line.
Brace hard — the unstable surface forces constant correction.
Keep the hips level; don't sag or pike.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: An intermediate minimal equipment core exercise for the abs. Swiss Ball Plank builds the trunk stability that underpins safe movement as you age.
